title: Hayati Pro Max Plus Pink Lemonade Prefilled Pod + Refill
description: Pink Lemonade delivers a bright, bubbly blend of sweet, berry-style lemonade with a light citrus note. The inhale combines Raspberry’s ruby tang with a sweet lemonade finish, followed by a gentle, cool note that keeps the flavour lively and crisp. Each Hayati Pro Max + Prefilled Pod is supplied as a prefilled 2ml pod connected to an integrated 10ml refill reservoir, giving 12ml total e-liquid at 20mg Nic Salt. No separate bottles, no manual topping up and no replacing coils. Attach the pod to the Hayati Pro Max + Prefilled Pod Kit and you’re ready to vape. The pod is built for discreet MTL use and uses a dual mesh coil to support consistent flavour and vapour. A single pod can deliver up to 6000 puffs (approx.), depending on personal habits. Once flavour fades or the reservoir runs dry, swap in a fresh Pink Lemonade pod. Discover more flavours with our full selection of Hayati Pro Max Plus Pods .
